correctness.rationale: Let X be the complex of all pairwise-intersecting families of triples of [8], 56 triple vertices (Ind(KG(8,3)) conventional; Feng KG(3,2)). Published Feng arXiv:2610.17394 Theorem 18 gives rational reduced ranks beta6=233, beta9=28, zero elsewhere; Feng–Wang arXiv:2404.10566 Theorem 10 proves independence of the 28 embedded six-ground-point nine-sphere cycles. A six-set stabilizer transposition flips fundamental crosspolytope orientation (15 axis inversions plus six antipodal flips => sign -1); H9 is Ind_{S6xS2}^{S8}(sgn6 tensor trivial). For each of 22 S8 classes invariant simplices correspond to independent orbit-families in conflict graph D_g, giving Ltilde(g)=-I(D_g;-1) and chi6=Ltilde+chi9. Independently rebuilt all 22 conflict graphs, exact independence-polynomial recursions, S8 character table through connected rim-hook Murnaghan–Nakayama, full orthogonality and rational class inner products. Confirmed nine multiplicity-one degree-six Specht partitions (8),(7,1),(5,3),(4,4),(4,3,1),(3,2,2,1),(2,2,2,2),(2,2,2,1,1),(1^8), dimension233; and two degree-nine hooks (3,1^5),(2,1^6), dimension28. Relies explicitly on the two published homology inputs; no integral or homotopy claim.
